title: Add streaming profile ingest pipeline + autosuggest release-blurb generator
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: The current onboard path batches full profile uploads which increases latency for new models and produces underspecified release notes. This PR implements a lightweight streaming ingest pipeline for incremental profile documents and an autosuggest release-blurb generator that drafts concise release notes from profile diffs. Goals: reduce perceived onboarding latency, surface early perf signals, and automate an initial release blurb to speed curator workflows. Solution: 1) Introduce a streaming ingestion service (ingest-stream) that accepts profile shards over gRPC and writes compact events to the registry event log; shards are validated incrementally and backpressure-aware batching is used to protect the DB. 2) Add a profile-delta microservice that subscribes to the event log, computes a compact delta (size, peak-alloc, perf-tokens) and writes a normalized delta record. 3) Implement autosuggest-release which uses light heuristics + a small TF-IDF ranking over recent changelog corpus to emit a 1-2 sentence blurb with suggested tags. 4) Add migration hooks to consume existing profile uploads and emit initial deltas for stable history. Rollout plan: start as opt-in flag on dev and staging, run canary for 48h on sample of onboard flows, then flip on for self-serve. Backfill: migration script to emit deltas for last 30 days. Related work: complements ENG-3120 (profile-compat) and PM-98 (reduce-onboard-latency).

review_comments: Marco Ruiz: Please add a circuit-breaker around the event log writer to avoid cascading failures; also elaborate on retention strategy for deltas.
Aisha Patel (author): Added circuit-breaker using token bucket (see processor.py) and added a retention config with default 90 days. Updated docs with retention rationale.
Ellen Cho: Tests look good but can we add a metadata field to tie delta records back to the onboarding request id for observability?
Aisha Patel (author): Added onboard_request_id to delta schema and propagated it through the ingestion RPC. Updated integration tests and logs.
Ravi Subramanian: Autosuggest looks promising. Two nits: 1) tune stopword list for our changelog corpus, 2) add telemetry for suggested-blurb accept/overwrite actions.
Aisha Patel (author): Tuned stopword list and added telemetry events (autosuggest.accepted, autosuggest.edited) emitted to telemetry pipeline.
release_notes: Added streaming profile ingest and autosuggest release-blurb generator. This reduces model onboarding latency and provides automated initial release notes to speed curator workflows. Opt-in canary rollout; migration/backfill script included.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in production, set DELTA_RETENTION_DAYS and INGEST_MAX_IN_FLIGHT. Watch event-log write latency and autosuggest telemetry for false positives. Canary overlay manifest provided under k8s/overlays/canary.
